verdict.rationale: Vanta's developer docs describe exactly this flow: pushing user accounts and custom resources from a homegrown app and turning them into pass/fail evidence with a Custom Test (vanta-docs-2), plus attaching evidence files via the Manage Vanta API (vanta-docs-31). Marketing for the Vanta API also covers automating evidence collection and testing for system categories like MDM, vulnerability scanners and background checks (vanta-docs-32), and AI skill files help build well-formed integrations (vanta-docs-27). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building a custom integration, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (standard paths returned 404), and official SDKs for the integration/Manage API (the evidenced SDKs cover only the Auditor API).
